facility.name: Rainbow Express Depot Ccc
facility.programs_provided: Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Non_Exact match: 104 E 2ND ST, VAN HORN, TX, 79855

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two children's files were missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Three personnel records were not at the operation for review, only their training hours were available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised: During inspection infant caregiver who is resposible for two infants in care exited the infant classroom leaving one infant unattended.    This was corrected at inspection when the infant caregiver returned to the infant room to care for the infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Basic Requirements for Infants - Never Unsupervised (26 TAC §746.2401(7))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: A 9 month old infant was asleep in a crib with a loose blanket covering the infant.   This was corrected when the blanket was immediately removed by the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant: Two infant cribs were not labeled.    This was corrected at inspection by having the cribs labeled for each infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Label for Each Infant (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(10))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: In review of staff records, three staff members did not have proof of training in administering medication available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: During inspection, four cots in the toddler classroom were not labeled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: Operation did not have a list of employees posted or available for review.    This was corrected at inspection when the person in charge printed a list of current employees and posted it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary: One child's food allergy emergency plan expired on 10/11/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary (26 TAC §746.3803(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation does not have available for review, documentation showing a  monthly check of the active play area and equipment was completed in the  month of May 2024.     This was corrected at inspection when the person in charge completed a monthly check list after checking the active play area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: Operation does not have documentation showing a fire inspection was completed in 2023 or 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: One child's epi-pen is not in the original container.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director present-Minimum 75%: Director of the operation is not present 75% of the time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director present-Minimum 75% (26 TAC §746.1011(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Two personnel records did not contain 24 hours of the required annual training available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders: Pre-K children were served cookies on a bare table.    This was corrected at inspection when a caretaker had children placed their cookies on top of napkins provided by the caretaker.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation Requirement - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §746.3317(6))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules: Two cribs in the infant room were not  labeled.  There was no numbering system in place.    This was corrected at inspections when the person in charge labeled the cribs with the infant's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Documentation that Crib Meets Applicable Federal Rules (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two caregivers working in the infant classroom does not have pediactrc first aid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: The operation does not have a current children's products certification.  The last available completed certification is dated 11/16/20.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance: The operation does not have a current annual verification of liability insurance. The operation has a next annual verification past due date of 6/22/2022.    This was corrected at inspection after a verification of liability insurance form 2962 was completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Liability Insurance (26 TAC §746.801(6))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list: The people list for employees associated with the operation has not currently been validated. The people list was last validated on 4/4/22.     This was corrected at inspection after the people list was reviewed with director and validated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation ? Every 3 months each operation, other than a licensed, registered, or listed home, must validate current list (26 TAC §745.651(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During inspection, in the pre-k classroom. a television was not observed to be securely anchored, thus posing a tip over hazard.  Photos taken.     This was corrected at inspection after director removed the TV and placed  in a storage room, not accessible to children. Photo taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
